description.value: The Ramen Butcher is an authentic Hakata-style tonkotsu ramen restaurant operated by Menya Kouji Enterprises, with noodles, gyozas, and rice bowls made in-house daily by chefs trained in Japan. The Burnaby location on Hastings Street offers a broad menu spanning classic tonkotsu, tsukemen, miso, and coconut curry ramens alongside donburi rice bowls and gyoza. It is one of two BC locations, with a second shop in Vancouver's Chinatown.

The website confirms takeout ('To-go') for the Burnaby location and lists several vegetarian menu items (Vegetarian ramen, Vege Tantan, Vege Gyoza), but contains no mention of bike parking, water refills, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or any other cycling-specific amenities.
